basic_info.description: Live above it all in this top-floor, penthouse-level one-bedroom, one-and-a-half bath condo. Outdoor space, air-conditioning & sweeping views! Built in 2014, ideally located in the heart of the coveted Duboce Triangle. Designed for both comfort and style, the home features soaring vaulted ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, wide plank wood flooring throughout, and dramatic views of Sutro Tower, Twin Peaks, Mission Dolores Park, and Salesforce Tower. Enjoy premium upgrades including new A/C, stainless steel appliances, a Bertazzoni gas range, and a luxurious rain shower in the spacious bathroom. The large bedroom offers an enormous walk-in closet, and the convenience of in-unit washer and dryer makes everyday living effortless. Building uses ButterflyMX system: secure seamless building access controlled by your phone. Additional private storage in basement.    Step outside to your private balcony, or just across the hall to a large shared terraceperfect for relaxing or entertaining. With Muni light rail and bus lines at your doorstep, quick access to 101, and neighborhood favorites like Duboce Park, Dolores Park, Whole Foods, Safeway, and Barry's Bootcamp just minutes away, this home combines unbeatable location with refined urban living. Leased parking next door.
